title: C2 Milestone 3: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Formidable! Has superado el tercer hito del nivel C2. Has demostrado un dominio absoluto de la persuasión ejecutiva, el vocabulario tecnológico y las estructuras gramaticales de fluidez (Participles) y énfasis (Clefting).

parts.visual:
En este tercer hito de C2 evaluaremos tu maestría en las lecciones 11 a 14: 

1. Participle Clauses: Being aware of (Razón), Having analyzed (Anterioridad), Seen from this angle (Pasivo). 
2. Fronting & Cleft Sentences: What I need is, It was John who, Into the room walked the CEO, Not until later did I realize.
parts.audio: In this third C2 milestone, we will evaluate your mastery of lessons 11 to 14. We will test Participle Clauses, like 'Being aware of', 'Having analyzed', and 'Seen from this angle'. We will also test Fronting and Cleft Sentences, like 'What I need is', 'It was John who', 'Into the room walked the CEO', and negative inversion like 'Not until later did I realize'.

parts.visual:
También repasaremos vocabulario de Tecnología y Persuasión: 

3. Advanced Technology: Disruption, Paradigm shift, Machine learning, Scalability, Bleeding-edge. 
4. Persuasion & Rhetoric: Leverage, Capitalize on, Pivot, Synergy, Spearhead, Watertight argument. 

¡Usa este arsenal para persuadir como un verdadero líder de la industria!
parts.audio: We will also review the vocabulary of Technology and Persuasion. From Technology: terms like Disruption, Paradigm shift, Machine learning, Scalability, and Bleeding-edge. From Persuasion: words like Leverage, Capitalize on, Pivot, Synergy, Spearhead, and Watertight argument. Use this arsenal to persuade like a true industry leader!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio C2 en este examen integral.

questions.question: ____ aware of the security risks, the IT team delayed the software launch. (Como eran conscientes).
Normal: I need your signature on this document. -> Emphasis: ____ I need is your signature on this document.
The invention of the internet was a massive ____ shift in how humans communicate.
We must ____ our brand reputation to attract top talent. (Aprovechar/Apalancar).
____ completed the audit, the accountants presented their findings to the board. (Después de haber completado).
questions.explanation: Having completed (Perfect participle para acción anterior terminada).

questions.question: ____ was the CEO who made the final call to fire the manager.
questions.explanation: It was the CEO who... (Cleft sentence).

questions.question: Artificial intelligence is causing unprecedented ____ across all sectors. (Disrupción).
The merger will create powerful ____ between our sales and marketing departments. (Sinergias).
Not ____ what the client wanted, I asked for clarification. (No sabiendo).
questions.explanation: Not knowing = As I didn't know.

questions.question: Normal: A mysterious black car waited outside the bank. -> Fronting: Outside the bank ____ a mysterious black car.
questions.explanation: Outside the bank waited... (Fronting con verbo de posición).

questions.question: Our cloud infrastructure offers infinite ____ to support our growing user base. (Escalabilidad).
The company had to ____ from selling hardware to providing software services to survive. (Pivotar).
____ from a financial standpoint, the investment is too risky. (Visto desde).
questions.explanation: Seen from = If it is seen from (Pasado participio pasivo).

questions.question: ____ they did was completely unethical. (Lo que ellos hicieron...).
We are using ____-edge technology, which is innovative but highly unstable.
Before we launch the campaign, we need to get ____ from all department heads. (Apoyo/Aceptación).
____ in 1850, the university is the oldest in the state.
questions.explanation: Founded = As it was founded (Pasado participio pasivo).

questions.question: Normal: I only want a chance to explain. -> Emphasis: ____ I want is a chance to explain.
The search engine's ____ is a closely guarded corporate secret.
His logic was flawless. It was a completely ____ argument. (Irrefutable).
____ aware of the danger, we stopped. (Como éramos conscientes)
____ finished, we left. (Habiendo terminado)
____ was John who did it. (Cleft sentence)
____ I need is time. (Lo que necesito...)
Market ____. (Disrupción con D)
Paradigm ____. (Cambio de paradigma con S)
____-edge. (Vanguardia extrema con B)
To ____ our resources. (Apalancar/Aprovechar con L)
To ____ a new strategy. (Pivotar con P)
Create ____. (Sinergias con S)
